name: Potential Credential Dumping Via WER
description: Detects potential credential dumping via Windows Error Reporting LSASS Shtinkering technique which uses the Windows Error Reporting to dump lsass
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Windows Error Reporting might produce similar behavior. In that case, check the PID associated with the "-p" parameter in the CommandLine.
query: ((process.executable:*\\Werfault.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:WerFault.exe) AND ((winlog.event_data.ParentUser:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*)) AND (user.name:(*AUTHORI* OR *AUTORI*)) AND (process.command_line:*\ \-u\ \-p\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \-ip\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \-s\ *))) AND (NOT process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\System32\\lsass.exe)
